Q8505.reason: Naturalism looks to the values that should ground international society, while positivism looks to the posited rules states have actually made.

Q8506.reason: By casting judgment as a syllogism whose conclusion is logically compelled, formalism denies that the judge has any authority to make law.

Q8509.reason: Universal jurisdiction lets every state prosecute particular grave crimes with no territorial or nationality link, not every international crime.
